findings.summary: Directory.Build.props still contains a comment that names the plugin version as 0.1.0.0 (now bumped to 1.0.1.0).
findings.detail: Directory.Build.props:15 (inside the IncludeSourceRevisionInInformationalVersion rationale comment) reads '... build.yaml/Directory.Build.props version 0.1.0.0 ...'. The task changed only the three version properties (<Version>/<AssemblyVersion>/<FileVersion>) as instructed, and the acceptance criterion concerns build.yaml metadata plus the version values, so this stale comment does not violate the acceptance criteria and has no functional effect (it is not read by MSBuild). It is nonetheless an inaccurate statement inside an in-scope file.
evidence: git diff Directory.Build.props -> only the three version property lines changed
findings.recommended_action: Correct the comment string to 1.0.1.0 the next time Directory.Build.props is edited (for example task 8.5/8.6); no change required for task 8.3.

findings.summary: docs/project-status.md still records the pre-bump package identity and Phase 7 as the current milestone; neither task 8.3 nor task 8.5's declared affected files cover it.
findings.detail: docs/project-status.md:513-536 states the default suite counts and describes the package as artifacts/ArrTags_0.1.0.0.zip (568,244 bytes, SHA-256 f6b6a515...) with 'Current milestone: Phase 7'. After this task the shipped package is ArrTags_1.0.1.0.zip (568,248 bytes, SHA-256 de4c3484...). The task 8.3 work instructions explicitly scope this task to build.yaml and Directory.Build.props and defer release-doc identity to task 8.5, whose declared affected files are only docs/release/build-and-release.md and docs/changelog.md. The stale identity in docs/project-status.md is therefore outside 8.3's assigned scope and does not affect its acceptance criteria, but it is not assigned to any Phase 8 task either, so it risks remaining stale after the phase.
evidence: docs/project-status.md:513 -> 'Passes 1,288 automated tests. The default ./build.sh test run passes 1,228'
findings.recommended_action: Have task 8.5 or the Phase 8 review reconcile docs/project-status.md with the 1.0.1.0 identity; not required for task 8.3.
